verses: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓا۟ أَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُمْ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَٰدِمِينَ

وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَٱلْفُسُوقَ وَٱلْعِصْيَانَ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ
فَضْلًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةً وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا فَإِنۢ بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُنَّ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَٰبِ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ

يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ رَّحِيمٌ
يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ

قَالَتِ ٱلْأَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓا۟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ
قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَٰمَكُم بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ

leads.title: The golden image and the fiery furnace ↔ Al-Hujurat: lowering voices, verifying reports, reconciling believers, backbiting and the peoples and tribes
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/07-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: Avoid suspicion, spying and backbiting: would one of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? (weight 6.3). Pair score 6.3.

Only in The golden image and the fiery furnace: God sends his angel to rescue his servants from death; All are commanded to bow to the king's image on pain of being thrown into a blazing furnace; The flames kill the men who throw the heroes into the furnace; A fourth figure appears walking in the fire, looking like a son of the gods (bar elahin); The furnace is heated seven times more than usual; The king sets up a golden image sixty cubits high and six wide on the plain of Dura; Envious courtiers 'eat the pieces' (slander) of the Jews and denounce their non-compliance to the king; The pagan king decrees that anyone who blasphemes or fails to fear the Jewish God will be punished; The rescued have not a hair singed, their garments unchanged, and no smell of fire on them; Long repeated list of imperial officials (satraps, prefects, governors, counselors, treasurers, judges, magistrates); A listed orchestra of instruments (horn, pipe, lyre, trigon, harp, symphonia) signals the moment to bow to the idol; The faithful declare that God can save them, but even if he does not, they will not serve the king's gods; and 7 more.

Only in Al-Hujurat: lowering voices, verifying reports, reconciling believers, backbiting and the peoples and tribes: Those who call the prophet from outside his private chambers (hujurat) lack understanding; they should wait until he comes out; They count their submission a favor to the prophet; rather God has done them a favor in guiding them; Let no people mock another, nor women other women, nor defame one another or insult with nicknames; If two groups of believers fight, make peace between them; fight the one that transgresses until it returns to God's command; The bedouin say 'we believe'; rather say 'we have submitted (aslamna)', for faith has not yet entered your hearts; The believers are nothing but brothers, so make peace between your brothers; One origin (one father, one pair, one God) as ground for conduct toward others [divergence between the texts]; Believers must not put themselves before God and his messenger, nor raise their voices above the prophet's or shout to him; Humanity created from a male and a female and made into peoples (shu'ub) and tribes to know one another; the noblest is the most pious; 'Have we not all one father? Has not one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously with one another?'; Slander or gossip pictured as eating [divergence between the texts]; If a corrupt person brings you news, verify it lest you harm a people in ignorance and come to regret it; and 4 more.

matches.note: Check a report before acting against a group: wə-dāraštā wə-ḥāqartā wə-šāʾaltā hêṭēḇ wə-hinnēh ʾĕmeṯ nāḵôn had-dāḇār vs. in jāʾakum fāsiqun bi-nabaʾin fa-tabayyanū an tuṣībū qawman bi-jahālatin fa-tuṣbiḥū ʿalā mā faʿaltum nādimīn. leads.title: Psalm 133, brothers dwelling together, oil and dew ↔ Al-Hujurat: lowering voices, verifying reports, reconciling believers, backbiting and the peoples and tribes
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/07-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: The believers are nothing but brothers, so make peace between your brothers (weight 6.7). Pair score 6.7.

Only in Psalm 133, brothers dwelling together, oil and dew: 'How good and pleasant when brothers dwell together in unity'; Like the dew of Hermon descending on the mountains of Zion, where God commanded blessing, life forever; Unity likened to the fine oil on the head running down the beard of Aaron onto the collar of his robes; Superscription 'A song of ascents' (shir ha-ma'alot), Ps 120-134.

Only in Al-Hujurat: lowering voices, verifying reports, reconciling believers, backbiting and the peoples and tribes: Those who call the prophet from outside his private chambers (hujurat) lack understanding; they should wait until he comes out; They count their submission a favor to the prophet; rather God has done them a favor in guiding them; Let no people mock another, nor women other women, nor defame one another or insult with nicknames; If two groups of believers fight, make peace between them; fight the one that transgresses until it returns to God's command; The bedouin say 'we believe'; rather say 'we have submitted (aslamna)', for faith has not yet entered your hearts; One origin (one father, one pair, one God) as ground for conduct toward others [divergence between the texts]; Believers must not put themselves before God and his messenger, nor raise their voices above the prophet's or shout to him; Humanity created from a male and a female and made into peoples (shu'ub) and tribes to know one another; the noblest is the most pious; 'Have we not all one father? Has not one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously with one another?'; Slander or gossip pictured as eating [divergence between the texts]; If a corrupt person brings you news, verify it lest you harm a people in ignorance and come to regret it; Avoid suspicion, spying and backbiting: would one of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother?; and 4 more.
